what_changed.mask: auto_mask.py v0.2.0: (1) branch arc finding — geodesic paths from bright off-axis spots to trunk, giving multi-path centerline coverage; (2) bifurcation detection from skeleton analysis, X coordinates recorded in reviewed JSON; (3) intruder classification (thin neck, tube corner, small size, perpendicular direction, low temporal correlation — pieces with ≥2 reasons flagged suspect); (4) local-SNR end trimming (columns with SNR < 1.2 at X extremes removed); (5) .mesc chunk period via FEMTO_ROOT-aware path resolution instead of autocorrelation fallback. Alpha calibration unchanged (max-curvature of size(alpha) curve).
what_changed.regions: auto_regions.py: bifurcation-aware naming. Without a detected bifurcation, only 'branch2' (distal-end convention). With a bifurcation, 'branch1/branch1far' for post-bifurcation main path, 'branch2+' for side paths. 6/20 runs now have detected bifurcations. Region window optimization via split-half reliability (within-region voxels only).
what_changed.stats: paper_stats.py v2.0 (stats2): replaced the meaningless one-sample Wilcoxon-vs-0 and wrong-direction binomial with a dual-null surrogate independence test. (A) Coupled-noise null: gain×reference + phase-randomized residual (preserves power spectrum). (B) Independent null: circular shifts of branch trace (≥20 s). BH-FDR on 10 cohort-level tests (5/10 significant at q<0.05). Phase randomization verified with np.allclose on |FFT|². Custom BH-FDR matches statsmodels.stats.multitest exactly (max diff ~1e-19).
what_changed.no_code_changes_to_mask_dice: Mask Dice unchanged (run05 0.734, run03 0.766). Root cause: the two curated cells need fundamentally different alpha values (run05 edge/peak ~0.17 needs alpha≤0.15; run03 edge/peak ~0.48 needs alpha≤0.50). The max-curvature calibration gives 0.29 and 0.36 — a principled compromise. With curated arcs, optimal per-cell alpha gives Dice 0.849 (run05) and 0.900 (run03). The gap is primarily arc quality and alpha adaptation. Overfitting risk: n=2 ground truth cells, so per-run tuning would be meaningless.

fixed_in_paper_stats: Coupled-noise null used residual=branch-gain*ref, which contains the branch's real independent events -> inflated null. Now noise = within-region voxel split (half1-half2)/2, per branch, events pooled per branch exactly like the observed statistic; independent null shifts all branches together.
Per-cell permutation p-values now (k+1)/(n+1); p=0 and p=1 cells were silently dropped from FDR (reported 2/3 and 2/8) and from Stouffer (pooled p 1e-16 -> 0.031).
Report text updated to describe the v3 nulls.
